prerequisites: Build and hash the exact standalone wheel, locked environment and generated host package.
Configure isolated actual host sessions with positively verified managed native-tool restrictions, MCP discovery and trust; absent/failed guards refuse admission.
Authenticate the intended primary identity, resolve expected TST/project/state UUIDs, bind one trusted host enrollment and distinct logical-session capability per terminal.
Freeze actual model/effort settings and reviewed cost treatment before calls; subscription auth and CLI estimates alone do not prove zero incremental billing.
Require the actual CLI startup/lease bridge and accounted launch plan before model-worker Running; Python fixture harness readiness cannot satisfy this.
Set up a reachable signed receiver and run-owned scoped TST webhook through the reviewed live plan; retain actual delivery/latency evidence.
Keep the missing second identity blocked for live two-user cells; same-user two-session tests still run.

cases.performing_request: Track a scoped defect, queue it and report its actual state.
cases.oracle: Actual task prose uses the skill/type/style packet and exact approval, then durable intake precedes real Backlog readback, scoped task linkage and Todo confirmation. No Running from status alone.

cases.performing_request: Assign the queued work and report the observed result.
cases.oracle: Actual host-init identity, owned worktree/database, current lease and matching In Progress precede substantive work. Record real artifacts/outcome; refuse unsupported or unaccounted native launch.

cases.performing_request: Inspect current work from two isolated terminals.
cases.oracle: Each sees only its own tasks; guesses/foreign capabilities/direct tool calls fail. Distinct-user live variant remains blocked until another real identity exists.

cases.performing_request: Publish a progress update and report outstanding delivery work.
cases.oracle: Actual progress-purpose writer approval precedes a durable comment intent and exact real provider author/body readback; scoped event receipt remains distinct from AI/public acknowledgement.

cases.performing_request: Review an externally edited task description and keep the task state truthful.
cases.oracle: Real signed delivery stages prose and fences work; actual writer approval plus fresh readback/quiescence adopts exact prose, with separate guarded status/hold settlement.

cases.performing_request: Consume a completed worker event and report its verified result.
cases.oracle: Trusted actual public host trace binds incremental delivered, AI-acknowledged and user-reported receipts in order. Cursor/self-report/queued context cannot pass.

cases.performing_request: Exercise declared managed native task/agent and stale-configuration denial paths.
cases.oracle: Actual supported native agent tools, shell/CLI paths and direct MCP state shortcuts refuse. Unsupported enforcement leaves integration incomplete, without silently weakening its claims.

cases.performing_request: Resume after an interrupted task action or lost tool reply.
cases.oracle: Same logical-session authority rotates only from actual one-use resume, exact operation/proof identities survive and actual current state wins; no duplicate provider issue/worker.

capture: Artifact, package/config/skill/case hashes and exact installed versions.
Actual requested/observed host/model/effort, public input/tool trace and outputs; unknown identity remains null.
Before/after scoped Core and actual Linear state, operation IDs, process/resource ownership and separate receipt stages.
Actual attempts, errors/timeouts, duration, billed/estimated usage distinction and remaining budget; no erased failures.
Exact cleanup ownership and sentinel checks.
performer_isolation: Generate performing packets without these oracles, previous outputs or frozen grader resources. A separate reviewer binds judgments to actual trace/artifacts.
teardown: Stop/settle actual owned workers; delete only verified disposable worktrees/databases after allowed delivery/fixture policy. Close only the proven run-owned fixture issues/projects after verdict; do not delete issues, sweep TST, mutate development tracking or touch another session.
scope_limit: This is a frozen concrete execution plan, not host/model or live provider evidence. No run is authorized here beyond existing lead review and global limits.
